requirements.text: The rideshare fare calculator shall print base fare plus time and distance charges, to two decimals.
requirements.source_quote: Read base fare, price per minute, price per mile, miles, minutes, and minimum fare from stdin. Print max(minimum fare, base fare + minutes * minute price + miles * mile price) with two decimals.
